item.title: GOG, a good idea is not enough
item.description: I backed GOG with my wallet for DRM-free games, yet Dome Keeper has been without the local co-op update for 195 days. A good mission does not replace reliable service — I ask for a clear status and plan.

item.title: AI and six trees: from an idea to an application
item.description: How AI helped me write to the authorities about protecting trees in Ursus. The application story, a practical guide and places to look for support.

item.title: Pellets in the litter tray: sifting with mesh
item.description: Two ordinary litter trays, an extra container and mesh used as a sieve. How I separate whole pellets from sawdust.
